cass-tullibee-upstream-minors.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-tullibee-upstream-minors.geojson.caveats: Tullibee (Cisco) Upstream Minors -- the HUC14 watersheds upstream of the refuge lakes, carrying the county's watershed-health assessment fields (Cisco_tier, wild rice, phosphorus, lake water-quality trend, MBS biodiversity, easements, forest/wetland protection). NOT the same schema as Watershed Minor (HUC 14): no prod_year/source fields. Field names are the service's truncated 10-character names; full meanings live in the county's service metadata. FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
